sam_sales: Quick transfer note for Helix Health — signed enterprise deal, go-live target in ~3 weeks. Core asks: Okta SSO, private VPC deployment, and a ramp plan for ~50k monthly tokens. ARR $120k, renewal cliff in 11 months. Tagging CS to run onboarding and ENG/support for infra tasks. SOW: https://redwood.co/sow/HLX-2026-01 :point_up:

maria_cs: Ill take point. A couple clarifying q's: Dedicated capacity vs hosted with VPC peering? Any special compliance docs beyond SOC2?

sam_sales: They want private deployment (VPC) + reserved/dedicated capacity for bursts. Compliance: SOC2 + EU data residency. Primary contact: emma@helix.example, +44 20 5555 1212. Preferred provisioning week: Apr 5.

maria_cs: Noted. Owners proposed: Maria (CS) onboarding lead, Lee (Support/Infra) SSO & peering, Anika (CS Ops) renewal & enablement.

maria_cs: My initial action items:
- Create Helix onboarding workspace and share SOW/docs.
- Draft success plan + milestones (prod target Apr 25).
- Schedule 1hr enablement with their ML infra team.

lee_support: Ill own the Okta/VPC work. Need Okta metadata and Helix VPC CIDR ranges. Creating infra ticket now with checklist.

lee_support: /ticket create --team=infra --priority=P2 --desc="Helix Okta metadata + VPC peering for private deploy" --owner=lee_support

reminder-bot: Calendar: Helix Kickoff  Apr 6 10:00 UTC (maria_cs, lee_support, anika_success, sam_sales). Invite sent.

anika_success: Ill track renewal risk and enablement outputs:
- Renewal cliff = 11 months  trigger QBRs starting month 6.
- Success metrics: latency SLO, monthly cost cap, feature adoption (chat + embeddings).
- Ill build a short feedback template for the 3-week check-in.

sam_sales: Helix confirmed peering window Apr 7-9. We should be good.

lee_support: Ill prioritize peering config on Apr 7. Will prepare rollback steps and post config snippet here.

lee_support: Draft config checklist:
``
- Collect Okta metadata XML
- Exchange VPC CIDRs (Helix / Redwood-proxy)
- Configure peering and update route tables
- Test private endpoint connectivity
- Validate KV-cache encryption and access controls
``

maria_cs: CS next steps: 1) 30-min internal pre-kickoff to review docs + SOW (maria_cs + anika_success + sam_sales), 2) invite product enablement for a training session 2w before go-live.

anika_success: Ill draft the pre-kickoff agenda and feedback poll; will send to Sam by EOD. Also adding a short enablement readiness form for Helix.

sam_sales: Approve once posted. Legal is prepping a data residency addendum to attach to SOW.

lee_support: Created ENG ticket INF-7842. Linking onboarding workspace and will update with network artifacts. Ping me for a test account if needed.

maria_cs: Lee, can you estimate downtime for peering change so I can inform Helix ops?

lee_support: Expect ~<15m disruption during BGP propagation; will schedule low-traffic window and document in INF-7842.

sam_sales: Helix also asked for a concise product roadmap covering real-time recall + embeddings. Can CS include a 1-pager in the kickoff pack?

maria_cs: Yes, Ill attach a 1-page roadmap + an onboarding checklist.

anika_success: Feedback capture request: ask Helix to rank latency vs cost vs feature parity in the kickoff form. This feeds Optimize recs.

sam_sales: Sounds good. Ping me if anything blocks before Apr 6. :thumbsup:

maria_cs: Creating workspace now and will post links and task owners here. :white_check_mark:

lee_support: Ill update INF-7842 with final peering plan and paste a short runbook here when complete.

reminder-bot: Reminder: internal pre-kickoff in 24h.

maria_cs: Pre-kickoff complete  workspace up: https://redwood.co/onboard/hlx-workspace. Owners assigned. Will update after customer kickoff. :rocket:
